calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    s.store_key,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) as staff_purchase_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
    AND r.return_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND r.return_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND p.sku IN (101624, 101778, 102244)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name;
